title: The Favor That Became a Habit
title_ja: 習慣になった頼みごと
fact_notes: 人物・具体的な出来事・制度・実験結果は架空の教材例。実在する統計、法制度、医療指示、実証研究を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Two close friends regularly studied together in the library after their classes had finished.
sentences.ja: 親しい友人二人は授業後に図書館でよく一緒に勉強した。

sentences.en: One of them, Leo, occasionally asked his friend to explain difficult homework questions.
sentences.ja: 一人のレオは時々難しい宿題の問題を説明してほしいと友人に頼んだ。

sentences.en: His friend was happy to help at first because she enjoyed reviewing the material through discussion.
sentences.ja: 友人は議論で教材を復習するのが好きで、最初は喜んで手伝った。

sentences.en: Over several weeks, however, Leo began to expect her assistance with almost every assignment.
sentences.ja: しかし数週間のうちにレオはほぼすべての課題で援助を期待するようになった。

sentences.en: The friend started spending less time on her own work because their study sessions often continued longer than planned.
sentences.ja: 勉強会が予定より長引くことが多く、友人は自分の勉強時間が減り始めた。

sentences.en: She worried that refusing a request might be interpreted as a sign that she no longer valued their friendship.
sentences.ja: 頼みを断ると友情を大切にしていないというサインに受け取られるのではと心配した。

sentences.en: Leo, meanwhile, assumed that his friend was comfortable with the arrangement because she had never complained.
sentences.ja: 一方レオは友人が不満を言ったことがないため取り決めに満足していると思い込んでいた。

sentences.en: Neither had discussed how much time they actually wanted to spend helping each other.
sentences.ja: 双方が互いにどれだけ援助に時間を使いたいか話し合ったことはなかった。

sentences.en: One afternoon, the friend explained that she needed to prepare independently for an upcoming examination.
sentences.ja: ある午後、友人は近づく試験のため自力で準備する必要があると説明した。

sentences.en: Rather than ending their study sessions completely, she suggested establishing a short period for shared questions.
sentences.ja: 勉強会を完全にやめるのでなく、質問を共有する短い時間を設けることを提案した。

sentences.en: Leo could attempt each problem first and bring only the questions that remained difficult after his own effort.
sentences.ja: レオはまず自分で問題に取り組み、その後も難しい質問だけを持ってこられる。

sentences.en: She also asked him to let her know in advance if he needed additional assistance.
sentences.ja: さらに追加の援助が必要なら事前に知らせてほしいと頼んだ。

sentences.en: Leo apologized for assuming that his friend would always be available whenever he needed help.
sentences.ja: レオは助けが必要なとき友人がいつも対応できると思い込んでいたことを謝った。

sentences.en: During their next meeting, he arrived with a smaller list of questions and several attempted solutions.
sentences.ja: 次の会合で少数の質問といくつかの試した解法を持ってきた。

sentences.en: His friend found it easier to explain the specific difficulties because he could show what he had already tried.
sentences.ja: すでに試したことを示せたので具体的な困難を説明しやすくなった。

sentences.en: They both had more time for independent work without losing the opportunity to learn together.
sentences.ja: 一緒に学ぶ機会を失わずに双方が自学の時間を増やせた。

sentences.en: The experience helped them understand that a repeated favor can gradually turn into an unspoken expectation.
sentences.ja: 繰り返す親切は徐々に言葉にされない期待になることがあると理解した。

sentences.en: Expressing a limit does not necessarily imply that a person cares less about a relationship.
sentences.ja: 限界を伝えることは必ずしも相手が関係を大切にしなくなったことを意味しない。

sentences.en: Rather, discussing practical needs may prevent frustration that could otherwise damage the relationship.
sentences.ja: むしろ実際の必要を話し合うことは関係を傷つけ得る不満を防ぐかもしれない。

sentences.en: For the two friends, continuing to support each other meant learning to ask and respond more thoughtfully.
sentences.ja: 二人にとって支え合いを続けるとは、より思慮深く頼み応じることを学ぶことだった。

questions.prompt: Why did the friend initially enjoy helping?
options: She wanted Leo to do all her homework.
She disliked studying alone in every situation.
She could review the material through discussion.
questions.explanation_ja: 議論を通じ復習できた。

questions.prompt: What problem developed for the friend?
options: She could no longer enter the library.
She had less time for her own work.
questions.explanation_ja: 自分の勉強時間が減った。

questions.prompt: Why did Leo think the arrangement was acceptable?
options: His teacher had told him it was compulsory.
His friend had never expressed dissatisfaction.
The school had set a fixed study period.
He had asked about the friend's schedule every time.
questions.explanation_ja: 不満を聞いたことがなかった。

questions.prompt: What new arrangement did the friend propose?
options: A short period for shared questions.
questions.explanation_ja: 質問のため短い時間を設ける。

questions.prompt: What was Leo encouraged to do first?
options: Ask another person to finish the assignment.

questions.prompt: What did Leo bring next time?
options: A list of all the friend's mistakes.
questions.explanation_ja: 少数の質問と試した解法。

questions.prompt: Why was the new arrangement helpful to both?
options: They could study independently while still helping each other.
It removed every difficult homework question.
It required both to have identical schedules.
questions.explanation_ja: 自学と協力を両立できた。

questions.prompt: What lesson does the passage emphasize?
options: Clear discussion of limits can support a friendship.
Friends should always accept every favor.
Asking for help is always wrong.
A refusal necessarily ends a friendship.
questions.explanation_ja: 限界を話し合うことは友情を支える。

grammar.explanation_ja: howeverは当初の好意と期待の増加を対比。

grammar.focus: might be interpreted as a sign
grammar.explanation_ja: might be＋過去分詞で可能性の受動態。

grammar.focus: Rather than ending their study sessions completely
grammar.explanation_ja: rather thanは選ばない行動を示す。
not necessarilyは必ずしも〜とは限らない。

paraphrases.source: Over several weeks, however, Leo began to expect her assistance with almost every assignment.
paraphrases.rewrite: After a few weeks, Leo nevertheless came to rely on her help for nearly all assignments.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 援助を当然と考えるようになった。

paraphrases.source: She worried that refusing a request might be interpreted as a sign that she no longer valued their friendship.
paraphrases.rewrite: She feared that saying no could be understood as a lack of care for their friendship.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 断ることが友情への関心不足と解釈されるのを心配した。

paraphrases.source: Rather than ending their study sessions completely, she suggested establishing a short period for shared questions.
paraphrases.rewrite: Instead of stopping their meetings altogether, she proposed a limited time to discuss questions.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 勉強会をやめず質問時間を制限する。

paraphrases.source: Expressing a limit does not necessarily imply that a person cares less about a relationship.
paraphrases.rewrite: Stating a boundary does not always mean someone values a relationship less.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 限界を伝えることは関係の価値を下げない。

discourse.role_ja: 援助と期待の変化を対比。
関係の中止ではなく調整へ。
限界を伝えることの意味を再評価。

cloze.explanation_ja: 頼みを断ることを心配した。
